title: Common providers: Lithuania
coverage: Partial. Covers the national fixed-line carrier, the three mobile network operators, the main cable and fibre operators and the research network; business ISPs and regional operators are thin.
missing: An AS number for Tele2 Lietuva and for Skaidula (none confirmed)
A website for Telia Lietuva (it refused an automated read on the read date)
Smaller business ISPs and data-centre operators
The regulator's list of service providers (not read)

sources.name: RRT (Communications Regulatory Authority): electronic communications providers
sources.terms: The page answered on the read date, in Lithuanian; no reuse licence was found on it, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: Page read for its address only; the list of providers was not read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Lithuania
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 1 of 12 names were found on the page (whole-word match; a name under three characters is not counted).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 11 of 12 websites and 0 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 12 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number registered to the provider but not announced was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: Its terms were not read: nothing is copied. Searched by name to find the numbers to confirm.
sources.result: Used to find candidate numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telia Lietuva
